title: Common-stage component of higher pullback tensor composition coherence
statement:
theorem pullbackTensorCommonStageCompositionCoherence {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : Z ⟶ X)
    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [hZ : ∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)] :
    ∀ M N : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Y,
      canonicalCommonStagePullbackTensor_composition l Ω f h M N

source.place: Tag 07A4, label lemma-pullback-tensor-product; component extracted from the parent composition proof.

proof.text: Apply the finite-stage representative calculation to M and N. Both composites are represented by the same morphism at one common coefficient stage, hence their common-stage Hom classes are equal.

from.place: Component decomposition of the three coefficient-level conclusions.
